clue.text: Playing a fanfare, and doing so well

definitions.meaning: a flourish is a showy burst of trumpets, so sounding one is this

explanation.surface: A trumpeter plays a fanfare and performs it splendidly.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: sounding a trumpet call, and prospering or thriving.

clue.text: Well qualified

definitions.meaning: suitable or competent for a role

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both healthy and suitable, so it covers each sense separately.

clue.text: Plant found right in the centre of florist's

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other here
the centre of a word is what remains once its outer letters are stripped away

explanation.surface: A plant spotted right in the middle of a flower shop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the centre of' strips FL and TS from FLORISTS, leaving ORIS; 'in' puts R inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Orris is the iris whose root is used in perfumery, so it is a kind of plant.

clue.text: In the pink, got up and took nourishment

explanation.surface: Feeling healthy, someone got out of bed and had breakfast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the pink' suggests good health, but here it is the colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Roseate means rosy-coloured, a shade of pink.

clue.text: Tender company for Napoleon, perhaps

parts.note: Napoleon is the pig leader of Orwell's Animal Farm; someone who tends such animals would keep him company

explanation.surface: A gentle companion for the French emperor.
explanation.walkthrough: Napoleon suggests the emperor, and 'Tender' looks like an adjective; it is one who tends, and Napoleon is Orwell's pig.
explanation.definitionFit: A keeper of pigs tends animals such as Orwell's porcine dictator.

clue.text: Plans wrongly cast aside

indicators.note: letters cast in the wrong places are rearranged

explanation.surface: Schemes have been mistakenly thrown away.
explanation.definitionFit: Plans and schemes are synonyms for notions of what to do.

clue.text: Such effusive types can make good guides

parts.note: ushers guide people to their seats

explanation.surface: Gushing people can make fine tour guides.
explanation.definitionFit: Effusive people pour out their feelings, like oil wells that spout.

clue.text: Friend knocking back drink

indicators.note: knocking back reads the word backwards here

parts.note: to lap is to drink like a cat

explanation.surface: A mate downing a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A pal is a mate or chum.

clue.text: Don't allow to copy, in plain language

indicators.note: one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: prose is ordinary written language, not verse

explanation.surface: Forbid copying, say it plainly.
explanation.definitionFit: To proscribe is to forbid or ban.

clue.text: He used to provide illumination, in many ways

definitions.text: He used to provide illumination, in many ways

parts.words: He used to provide illumination, in many ways
parts.note: the old street worker who lit the gas lamps; both a lamp and a lighter give light

explanation.surface: A man who once brought enlightenment in various ways.
explanation.definitionFit: Before electric street lighting, a worker went round lighting the gas lamps each evening.

clue.text: Revolver that's used to secure an admission

definitions.text: Revolver that's used to secure an admission

parts.words: Revolver that's used to secure an admission
parts.note: not a pistol extracting a confession, but a rotating gate that lets one person enter

explanation.surface: A gun used to force a confession.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolver' and 'admission' suggest a gun and a confession; the device turns and admits visitors.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotating barrier lets people through one at a time on paying entry.

clue.text: Rant and swear like a trooper (sort of)

definitions.meaning: the word goes before trooper to make the Nazi soldier, so it is a kind of trooper

explanation.surface: Shout and curse like a soldier, more or less.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' says the word is only one type of trooper: the storm trooper.
explanation.definitionFit: To rage angrily is a sense of the word, and a Nazi assault soldier was a trooper of this name.

clue.text: Spectacular downfall of villain in court action

indicators.note: one piece sits within the other

explanation.surface: A rogue's dramatic fall during a lawsuit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'downfall' looks like ruin, but it is falling water.
explanation.definitionFit: A waterfall tumbling down in stages is a spectacular fall of water.

clue.text: Cutting short illness with initial remedy mostly on time

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above the next piece
the remedy part is placed at the start of the illness
mostly means the last letter is dropped

explanation.surface: Shortening an illness by an early cure, almost on schedule.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' means above, so the shortened remedy ('mostly') sits over the time letter, and 'with initial' fixes that pair at the front of the illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Curtailing something is cutting it short, so the noun is a shortening.

clue.text: Openings must be created for this pattern maker

definitions.text: Openings must be created for this pattern maker

parts.words: Openings must be created for this pattern maker
parts.note: a cut-out sheet with holes through which paint or ink makes a design

explanation.surface: A designer must create opportunities.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheet with cut-out shapes lets paint through to reproduce a design.

clue.text: Highland feature it's good to see during trip

indicators.note: during puts one piece in the middle of the other

explanation.surface: A pleasant sight on a Highland journey.
explanation.definitionFit: A long raised crest of land is a feature of hill country.

clue.text: Study English outside class time I fix

indicators.note: outside puts the first pieces around the next ones

parts.note: a term is a school period

explanation.surface: A student repairs something outside lesson time.
explanation.definitionFit: To fix a date is to settle or decide it.

clue.text: Recruitment of leaderless men inclined to join up

indicators.note: leaderless means the first letter is lost

parts.note: taken as written before losing its first letter
listing means leaning, like a ship

explanation.surface: Signing up men without a leader who are keen to join.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inclined' suggests willing, but means leaning over.
explanation.definitionFit: Enlisting is signing up for the forces, the act of recruitment.

clue.text: Excited cats in midst of vermin abandoned pursuit

indicators.note: one piece placed within the other
excited letters are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: Agitated cats among rats give up the chase.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoned pursuit' reads like a verb phrase but is the definition; 'Excited' scrambles the cats into STCA, which 'in midst of' sets inside the vermin.
explanation.definitionFit: A hopeless cause is an endeavour already given up on.

clue.text: Nothing on summit in mountain range down under

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: the Andes are a South American range

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means placed after

explanation.surface: Nothing at the top of a mountain range in Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: Places on the opposite side of the globe, used by Britons for Australia and New Zealand.

clue.text: Guide dog

definitions.meaning: an indicator or needle that shows the way
a gun dog breed that points at game

explanation.definitionFit: Both a needle that indicates and a hunting breed that indicates game share the name.

clue.text: Meadow, in part, used for fold

indicators.note: one piece is inside the other

parts.note: lea is a poetic word for meadow

explanation.surface: Part of a meadow used as a sheep fold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fold' suggests a sheep pen, but means a crease.
explanation.definitionFit: A pleat is a doubled crease in fabric.

clue.text: Ceremonial display, one that's uplifting in European city hit by disaster

indicators.note: in a down clue, uplifting reads the pieces from the bottom up

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
i.e. is short for that is

explanation.surface: A ceremony with an inspiring figure in a disaster-struck city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uplifting' reverses I and IE together to give EII.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman city near Naples was buried by Vesuvius in AD 79.

clue.text: Offering bait to entrap king in ambush

indicators.note: to entrap means to surround the next piece

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Baiting a trap to catch a monarch in an ambush.
explanation.definitionFit: Lying hidden waiting to pounce is lying in wait.

clue.text: Crop runs into profit

indicators.note: into puts one piece inside the other

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A harvest brings in money.
explanation.definitionFit: Cereal such as wheat is a harvested crop.

clue.text: Fellow member in firm always succeeding

indicators.note: one piece is placed within the other
succeeding means coming after the firm

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company
e'er is a poetic contraction of ever

explanation.surface: A fellow MP in a company always does well.
explanation.definitionFit: A compeer is a peer or companion of equal standing.

clue.text: Correct conclusion about the writer

indicators.note: about means wrapped around

parts.note: the writer refers to the setter, so me

explanation.surface: Fix the ending about the author.
explanation.definitionFit: To emend a text is to correct its errors.

clue.text: It's defined as."order" in English dictionary

explanation.surface: A dictionary entry defines a word as command.
explanation.definitionFit: An edict is an official decree or command.

clue.text: Diversion providing an essential cover for English soldiers

indicators.note: a cover goes outside, so one piece wraps the other

explanation.surface: Entertainment as a vital shelter for English troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Amusement is entertainment that diverts the mind.

clue.text: Sailor's topping navigational aid

indicators.note: topping means removing the top letter

explanation.surface: A seaman's best navigational aid.
explanation.definitionFit: Tar is an old slang word for a seaman.

clue.text: Couple in endless row

indicators.note: endless means the last letter is dropped

explanation.surface: A pair caught in a never-ending quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' suggests a quarrel, but means a line of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: To couple is to join together, to fasten.

clue.text: New danger — fire wayward? This should improve its accuracy.

indicators.note: wayward letters stray into a new order

explanation.surface: A risk of wild firing that a device should help correct.
explanation.definitionFit: A device measuring distance to a target makes the gunner's aim truer.
